# CANDIDATE: RELAX_RIBBON_SPREAD_BEARISH_REJECTION_20_TO_30C

**Filed:** 2026-09-11

## Hypothesis

Relaxing the ribbon spread filter from ≥30 cents to ≥20 cents will increase trade frequency by capturing more bearish rejection setups during 2026 Q3, while maintaining sufficient edge to improve OP-16 edge_capture. The wider filter admits more trades in choppy/transition regimes where the ribbon is tight but still directionally biased.

## Mechanism

Change `ribbon_spread_min_cents` in BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON from 30 to 20. Entry trigger remains: level rejection + EMA ribbon flip (bearish) + confluence with multi-day/premarket structure (≥2 of 3). Exit logic unchanged: primary chart stop (rejected level + $0.50 buffer), chandelier profit-lock (trail 0.15 off HWM after +50% TP1), catastrophe premium stop (−50%), time stop 15:50 ET.
